   (DO ((I (1- (VECTOR-LENGTH V)) (1- I))

       ((< i 0) RESULT)
    (SETQ RESULT (+ (ROT RESULT -1) (SXHASH (VREF V I))))
or maybe the last line could even include in the index I somehow
    (+ (ROT RESULT -1) (randomify I) (SXHASH (VREF V I)))
